name: EPIC 228735241

text.card: A red giant 2,728 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.03 solar masses and 6.2 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,753 K at its surface.
